description: I'm a Apoorva and engineering enthusiast passionate about technology and innovation. I'm exploring Earth Information Jukebox, an idea that transforms NASA's Earth science data into sounds and musical experiences through data sonification. Imagine hearing changes in climate, oceans, forests and our planet's environment! I may still have a lot to learn, but I'm eager to develop my technical skills, explore unfamiliar concepts  to build something meaningful.
summary:
Anunaad (अनुनाद)

Anunaad is an interactive web-based Earth science platform developed to make complex environmental information easier to explore and understand. The project brings together different aspects of our planet, including oceans, climate, and hazards, through interactive visualizations and data-driven sound (sonification). It uses technologies such as React, Vite, Python, and Flask to display and process information collected from sources like NASA, NOAA, and FIRMS.

Anunaad addresses the challenge of making large amounts of scientific and environmental data accessible to everyone. Instead of relying only on technical reports, numbers, and graphs, users can explore Earth through visual experiences and sound. This makes learning more engaging and helps people develop a better understanding of environmental changes and natural events. The project is important because it connects technology with environmental awareness and encourages people to explore and understand our changing planet.
details:
Anunaad (अनुनाद)

Anunaad is an interactive web-based platform designed to make Earth science more accessible, engaging, and easier to understand. It allows users to explore different parts of our planet, including oceans, climate, land, vegetation, and natural hazards, through interactive visualizations and data-driven sound (sonification).

How it works: The platform uses a React-based frontend to display interactive maps, 3D visualizations, and environmental information. A Python Flask backend retrieves and processes data from sources such as NASA, NOAA, and FIRMS through API connections. The processed information is then displayed on the website, allowing users to explore environmental patterns and natural events. Sonification adds another way to experience and understand Earth data through sound.

Benefits and intended impact: Anunaad helps bridge the gap between complex scientific data and everyday users. It encourages curiosity about our planet, improves awareness of environmental changes, and makes learning about Earth science more interactive. It can serve as an educational platform for students, educators, and anyone interested in understanding the planet.

Tools and technologies used: We developed the frontend using React, Vite, and CSS, and the backend using Python and Flask. We integrated data from NASA, NOAA, and FIRMS. GitHub was used for version control and collaboration, while Vercel and Render were used to deploy the frontend and backend.

Creativity and innovation: The unique aspect of Anunaad is its combination of scientific data, interactive visual exploration, and sonification. Instead of presenting environmental information only through numbers and reports, it gives users a more immersive way to experience Earth.

Factors considered: Our team focused on accessibility, ease of navigation, meaningful data visualization, reliable data sources, user engagement, and the performance of the website. We aimed to create an experience that is informative, visually engaging, and useful for people with different levels of scientific knowledge.
